title: MER Measurement
text: Measure modulation error ratio in digital modulation applications, 2 inputs, 4 outputs, {Measurement interval} sets Measurement interval source Input; {Reference signal}, {Reference constellation}, {Custom measurement interval}, {Averaging dimensions}, {Output minimum MER} sets the option to add min port to output minimum MER, {Output X-percentile MER} sets the option to add X% port to output X -percentile MER, {X-Percentile value (%)} sets the value below which X % of MER measurements, {Output the number of symbols processed} sets the option to add nSym port to output number and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Ref
ports.summary: Reference signal scalar | vector | matrix | 3-D array

ports.name: Rcv
ports.summary: Received signal scalar | vector | matrix | 3-D array

ports.name: MS
ports.summary: Percentage MER of received signal scalar

ports.name: X%
ports.summary: Value below which X % of MER measurements fall scalar

params.name: Reference signal
params.values: Reference signal source Input port | Estimated from reference constellation

params.name: Measurement interval
params.values: Measurement interval source Input length (default) | Entire history | Custom | Custom with periodic reset

params.name: Averaging dimensions
params.values: Averaging dimensions 1 (default) | vector of integers in the range [1, 3]

params.name: Output minimum MER
params.values: Option to add min port to output minimum MER measurements Off (default) | On

params.name: Output X-percentile MER
params.values: Option to add X% port to output X -percentile MER measurements Off (default) | On

params.name: X-Percentile value (%)
params.values: Value below which X % of MER measurements fall 95 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 100]

params.name: Output the number of symbols processed
params.values: Option to add nSym port to output number of symbols Off (default) | On

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
